name: Normandy Beaches - Omaha, Easy Red
description: Easy Red and the E-1 draw, 6 June 1944: the tidal flat with its four obstacle belts, the shingle and seawall, wire, mines and the anti-tank ditch on the sand shelf, WN65 (R667 casemate) and WN64 (unfinished R612) on the bluff, the draw road through the bocage to Saint-Laurent-sur-Mer. Five objectives, Allies attack from the landing craft. 1200 x 2400 m.
